name: Amber Fort (Amer Fort)
description: Majestic hilltop fort built in yellow & pink sandstone, featuring Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace), Diwan-e-Aam, and panoramic views of Maota Lake.

name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
description: Five-storey pink facade built with 953 intricate honeycomb windows (jharokhas) designed to let royal women observe street festivals unseen.

name: Lake Pichola Boat Ride
description: Iconic artificial freshwater lake created in 1362 AD. Cruising past Jag Mandir Island, Taj Lake Palace, and City Palace during sunset is legendary.

name: Baga Beach & Water Sports
description: Goa's famous beach hub offering jet skiing, parasailing, vibrant shacks, live acoustic music, and night flea markets.

name: Dal Lake & Houseboats
description: The Jewel in the Crown of Kashmir. Floating flower markets, carved wooden houseboats, and snow mountain reflections on calm waters.

name: Pangong Tso Lake
description: Situated at 13,862 feet, Pangong Lake shifts colors from turquoise blue to deep violet throughout the day.

name: Solang Valley Adventure Hub
description: Renowned center for skiing, zorbing, paragliding, ropeway rides, and snow quad biking in the Himalayas.

name: Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7)
description: Voted Asia's Best Beach by Time Magazine. Powder white sand, lush mahua trees lining the shore, and crystal clear turquoise sea.
